messages:
maria: CI red on the runtime tests again, this time in the new prefetch path. Job: https://ci.redwood.internal/12345 :grimacing:
ci-bot: Job 12345 failed: 1 test failed (test_eager_prefetch_timer). Logs uploaded: https://ci.redwood.internal/12345/artifacts
aj: @maria can you paste the failing assertion?
maria: here's the std output around the failure:
```
thread 'test_eager_prefetch_timer' panicked at 'deadline (123456789) <= now (123456789)', runtime/prefetch/scheduler.rs:214:9
stack backtrace: ...
```
aj: looks timing-y. Try a rerun + run with single test thread: `RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 cargo test --test runtime_tests test_eager_prefetch_timer -- --nocapture`
devon: i saw something similar on my dev laptop after the prefetch reorder PR landed (PR #3421). suspect the timer jitter + batch coalescing. quick local probe:
```
RUST_LOG=debug cargo test -p runtime --test runtime_tests test_eager_prefetch_timer -- --exact --nocapture
```
sasha: i can kick a manual rerun on the CI now :working_on_it: (rerun: https://ci.redwood.internal/12346)
ci-bot: Rerun 12346 started by sasha
sasha: rerun 12346 passed green, artifacts attached. so it's intermittent.
maria: thanks. can someone try a tiny bisect around PR 3399..3430? my hunch is the scheduling tweak in 3421.
aj: i'll do a quick git bisect on my machine and try to reproduce with `--seed` to catch nondeterminism. if anyone hits it locally, please leave the exact seed and run cmd here.
devon: note: if you can't repro locally, try 50 iterations with seed sweep: `for s in {1..50}; do RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 cargo test ... -- --exact --seed $s || break; done` — that found it for me at seed=17
maria: nice, can you paste the failing seed & backtrace?
devon: seed=17, same assert. backtrace attached in artifact 12346/tests/seed17.log
aj: i'm going to open a small issue and mark the test flaky + add a CI retry policy for this test until we root cause. sasha, can you add the ci label?
sasha: done — created issue INFRT-512 and added `ci:flaky-test` tag. i'll also add a job-level 1x retry on the test shard as a short-term mitigation.
maria: long term we should either make the timer deterministic in test (fake clock) or add an explicit jitter guard. adding to INFRT-512. thanks folks :thumbsup:
